description: This file defines the CorporateDirectoryModuleController class, which manages the corporate directory module within the OrangeHRM system. It handles dependency injection for JobTitleService and LocationService, prepares data for rendering by creating a Vue component and adding relevant props such as job titles and locations.

classes.name: CorporateDirectoryModuleController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the corporate directory module, enriching the UI component with job titles and location data for the Vue frontend.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JobTitleService instance.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocationService instance.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties for job titles and locations before rendering.
